---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new capability or a change in behavior
title: ""
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What you're trying to do, and where the current CLI/skills fall short. Prefer
a concrete scenario over an abstract ask — "when I `/operate` a demand that
touches N repos, I have no way to X" beats "it would be nice to have X".

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see. If it changes a CLI subcommand's contract or a
skill's flow, say which one.

## Alternatives considered

Other ways to solve the same problem, and why you didn't prefer them.

## Additional context

Anything else — related issues, prior discussion, a sketch of the CLI
output/flag shape you have in mind.
